title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Salah 1491 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. Prayer 3270 views Q. (1) Jab fazaile amaml ki talim hoti hai to usme kai bar HUZUR(S.A.W.) ka naam ata hai to kya har baar durood sharif parhna zaruri hai? (4)juma ke khutbe me ab log buland awaz se durood nahi padhte halan ki thode sal pahle padhte the kya buland awaz se durood padhna mana hai? 3387 views Q. Masla-e-Kasr A man who lives 50 miles away from his office and where he does his job and his company allows him two days holidays in two weeks, Then he goes to his home for two days (within/before 15 days). He goes every next week & continue i.e. before 14 days in counting. He goes on Friday and returns backs to his office on Sunday evening (if days count, then days shall be counted before 14 days). I ask you that,the masla of Kasr shall be applicable on him or not? What will be your answer if he continues every week? 1849 views Q. How will a muslim pray in Space 2768 views Q. Note that their intention is not to willingly miss the first jama't but due to some sharia necessity they missed first one...I have heard that people in Madinah do offer many second jama'ts. 3037 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 8544 Country: India Title: is it necesarry to offer shukrana namaz though our hajat is not fulfilled (after offering saltul haja)? Question: is it necesarry to offer shukrana namaz though our hajat is not fulfilled (after offering saltul haja)? Answer ID: 8544 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2097/1659=H/1429) It is not wajib (necessary). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
